name: China Merchants Bank Co., Ltd.
summary: China Merchants Bank Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries provide banking and financial services through wholesale finance, retail finance and other business segments. Individuals can open checking, savings, time deposit and renminbi accounts and take housing, vehicle, consumption and education loans, while corporate clients get working capital, fixed asset and trade financing. It also offers credit cards, insurance, funds, advisory and underwriting, cross-border RMB clearing and wealth management.
